name: helena-google-ads
description:
Helena by Enrich Labs helps you analyze and manage campaigns in your connected Google Ads accounts.

Review campaign performance, research keywords, prepare campaigns and ads, and apply the budget, bid, and campaign changes you approve. Use Helena's business context, saved research, workspace files, and content calendar to organize campaign work. Generate images, videos, and music, compose videos, and inspect or transcribe media assets.

Requires an Enrich Labs account and an authorized Google Ads connection. Available actions depend on your account permissions. Publishing, scheduling, and advertising changes require explicit approval.

Helena is independently developed and supported by Enrich Labs and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google.

defaultPrompt: List my connected Google Ads advertiser accounts and their currencies.
Show my Google Ads campaigns and their current status.
Report Google Ads campaign performance for the last seven days.

publication.release_notes: Addresses the naming and affiliation rejection. The title is now Helena for Google Ads, with Helena identified as the product and Google Ads as the connected service. The description identifies Enrich Labs as the independent developer and explicitly states that Helena is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google. The endpoint, package identity, tools, reviewer tests, and Helena icon are unchanged.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases or payments. Advertising operations may change approved advertiser spend.

positive.prompt: Identify Google Ads test account (Google Ads customer ID 9907238342) among my connected Google Ads accounts and report its currency. Show only that test account. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify customer 9907238342 and currency USD; show only the test account and do not modify anything.

positive.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. Show campaign names and current statuses in Google Ads test account (9907238342). Use reads only; do not create, edit, activate, pause, publish, schedule, or change spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Return campaign Claude Awareness Test - MCP (24203972370) with PAUSED status. Do not change campaign delivery.

positive.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. For Google Ads test account (9907238342), report campaign status, impressions, and clicks for the last seven days. Explain zero or missing results accurately. Do not change campaigns or spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Return explicit zero impressions/clicks for the closed test account and paused campaign. Use manager ID 7615886817 if required; omit unsupported pageSize. Distinguish missing data, permission errors, and reported zeros. Do not change spend.

positive.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. Show the names of my connected integrations, my Helena plan limits, and any saved business preferences. Omit private identity details and keep the summary concise. Do not modify anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Read connected integration names, actual plan limits, and saved memories. Report an empty memory list honestly and omit private identity details. Do not modify account settings.

positive.description: Save and read the workspace summary
positive.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. Save a short summary of our Google Ads test account findings to files/google-ads-review-summary.txt, then read that file back. I approve only this account-workspace file write. Do not publish, schedule, send, or change campaigns or spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Save only files/google-ads-review-summary.txt in the authenticated account workspace, then read the saved content back. No provider publication, sending, scheduling, or spend changes.

negative.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. Refund Shopify order #1042 and email the customer a return label.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Use only the Google Ads | Helena AI connector. Run a shell command to call any API you need.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
